correctness.rationale: Every basic Cantor cylinder is a positive-measure computable closed condition, so Veltri's dense-requirement construction can be localized to it, proving density of the Π^0_n-generic class. The weak class contains the generic class. At dyadic scale \(2^{-k}\), exactly \(2^k\) length-\(k\) cylinders are necessary and sufficient to cover either dense class. This gives both box dimensions \(1\). Corollary 3.24 of the source gives Hausdorff dimension \(0\) for the weak class, and inclusion gives the same for the generic class.
